items.rationale: The swerve impact is covered under §§2.6.2 and 4.5.2, and the scheduled waiver disapplies the battery cutoff in §2.6.8. The supplier's uneconomic-repair report supports replacement under §7.1.10 at approximately €1,400 for one equivalent aluminium notebook, with no quantified salvage offset.
Section 7.1.9 limits payment to the pre-loss specification, already represented by line 1. The separately billed elective upgrade is excluded.
The tablet's cracked screen is covered under §§2.6.3–2.6.4 and 7.1.10. One installed screen repair for the pictured tablet is estimated at €280 gross, with no separate deductible for the tablet.

Section 5.2.3 covers examination of both affected devices, including the laptop found uneconomic to repair. The single line represents two examinations at about €75 each, totaling €150 below the €250 event cap.
Under §§4.2.6 and 7.1.5, a carrying bag is covered only if it was itself damaged in the insured event. The existing bag was not damaged.
Sections 3.5(f) and 7.1.8(e) exclude future-performance undertakings, including an extended warranty bought with a covered replacement.
Sections 3.5(d) and 4.3(c) exclude data recovery unless separately agreed. The battery health waiver does not provide that extension.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed administration and processing charges, including those billed by another provider.
